study_badge: MULTICENTER OBSERVATIONAL COHORT · STROBE · SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA
title: Early SGLT2 Inhibitor Initiation Within 72 Hours of Acute Heart Failure Admission and 24-Month Cardiorenal Outcomes
authors_line: Elena Rostova, MD, PhD¹; Marcus Vance, MD¹; Tariq Al-Mansoor, MPH²; Hannah Lindqvist, PhD²
affiliations_line: ¹Dept. of Cardiovascular Medicine, Synthetic Academic Health Network; ²Center for Clinical Biostatistics (Synthetic Demonstration Study)

items.title: 01  Clinical Background & Objective
paragraphs: Acute decompensated heart failure (ADHF) hospitalization marks high vulnerability for recurrent congestion and progressive kidney decline [1]. Whether initiating SGLT2 inhibitors within 72 hours of inpatient stabilization improves 24-month cardiorenal survival across ejection fraction strata remains uncertain.
bullets: Primary Objective: Compare 24-month composite cardiovascular death, HF rehospitalization, or ≥40% sustained eGFR decline between early inpatient SGLT2i (≤72 h) vs. standard post-discharge care.

items.title: 02  Cohort Derivation & Propensity Weighting

steps.title: Adults Hospitalized With ADHF (19 Centers)
steps.excluded_detail:
eGFR <20 mL/min (n=510)
Type 1 diabetes (n=190)
Prior SGLT2i use (n=620)

steps.title: Overlap Propensity-Weighted Comparison
steps.detail:
Early SGLT2i ≤72 h (n = 2,410) vs. Standard Care (n = 2,410)
Covariate standardized mean differences all <0.03

items.caption: Figure 1. STROBE cohort selection across 19 hospitals (N = 4,820; synthetic cohort).

items.title: 03  Statistical Architecture
bullets: Exposure: Empagliflozin or dapagliflozin started ≤72 h of IV loop diuretic stabilization.
Models: Overlap propensity-weighted Cox models & Fine-Gray competing-risk regression adjusted for age, LVEF, NT-proBNP, baseline eGFR, and background GDMT [2].

items.title: Primary 24-Month Cardiorenal Composite
paragraphs: Early SGLT2i initiation reduced cumulative 24-month event incidence from 29.8% (718/2,410) to 21.4% (516/2,410), corresponding to an absolute risk reduction of 8.4% (NNT = 12).

items.title: 04  24-Month Event-Free Survival
items.caption: Figure 2. Overlap-weighted Kaplan-Meier cardiorenal event-free survival with shaded 95% CIs and aligned number at risk (N = 4,820).

items.title: 05  Component & Safety Endpoints
items.footnote: Subgroup p-interaction by LVEF phenotype = 0.64. Euglycemic DKA was exploratory safety outcome.

items.title: 06  Strengths & Limitations
bullets: Strengths: Active-comparator new-user design across 19 centers with adjudicated renal laboratory trajectories.
Limitations: Residual confounding by unmeasured inpatient diuretic responsiveness cannot be excluded; post-12-month adherence relied on dispensation claims.

items.title: Clinical Conclusions
paragraphs: Initiating SGLT2 therapy within 72 hours of inpatient ADHF stabilization was associated with a 32% relative hazard reduction in 24-month cardiorenal events across HFrEF and HFpEF phenotypes, without excess ketoacidosis or acute renal injury.

references: [1] Voors AA et al. Nat Med 2022;28:568–574.
[2] Li F, Morgan KL, Zaslavsky AM. JASA 2018;113:390–400.
